policy.consumable: Shared usable item result is authoritative; reliable native item results retain unknown/false without querying non-action effect spells. Empty/mana/native item range remain shared. Item range replaces effect-spell range for ordinary item faces, matching item macros. Managed item pins survive changed/cached macro translation; stale spell/charge identity is cleared and item-change usability/mana caches reset. Wisp and buff countdown policy retained.
policy.focus: Compact focus borders retain exact accepted half widths and current icon/font settings. A shared anchor helper is used by create/re-enable and relayout. Content translation reproduces target body-relative first-icon origins (-2 buff,-5 debuff), header-contact baseline and caption baseline, converted to independent panel scale. Both Lua positioner and native AuraContainer use the same translation; focus native container clipping is disabled to permit target-style overhang. Caption anchors cache unchanged geometry. Target/legacy metrics/offsets retained. Captions also retain target body-relative horizontal origins (-3.5 buff,-6.5 debuff), with cached x/y anchors.
